title: MMPCBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Proactive Critique of Flawed Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2608.29286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) evolve into sophisticated interactive assistants, their reliability depends not only on following instructions but also on validating them. We define Proactive Critique as the model's autonomous ability to identify, analyze and fix faulty user inputs without extra prompts. However, evaluations mainly test models under ideal circumstances or simple refusal behaviors, largely ignoring active error processing. To fill this gap, we propose MMPCBench, a comprehensive framework for evaluating MLLMs' proactive critique competence. It features a fine-grained taxonomy of 4 primary error types spanning 12 subcategories, ranging from cross-modal contradictions to missing visual premises. We adopt a hierarchical evaluation protocol to measure models' error detection, diagnosis and resolution performance, and apply alignment-aware metrics to assess the coherence between internal reasoning and final response

translated_title: MMPCBench：面向有缺陷输入的主动批判能力对多模态大语言模型进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）逐渐演变为复杂的交互式助手，其可靠性不仅取决于遵循指令，还取决于对指令的验证。我们将“主动批判”定义为模型在无需额外提示的情况下自主识别、分析和修复用户错误输入的能力。然而，现有评估主要在理想情况或简单拒绝行为下测试模型，在很大程度上忽略了主动的错误处理。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MMPCBench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型主动批判能力的综合框架。该框架包含一个细粒度的错误分类体系，涵盖4种主要错误类型和12个子类别，范围从跨模态矛盾到缺失的视觉前提。我们采用分层评估协议来衡量模型在错误检测、诊断和解决方面的表现，并应用对齐感知的指标来评估内部推理与最终回答之间的一致性。
tldr: 提出了MMPCBench基准，通过包含4大类12子类错误的细粒度分类体系、分层评估协议和对齐感知指标，首次系统评估多模态大语言模型主动识别、分析和修复有缺陷用户输入的能力。
en_tdlr: We propose MMPCBench, a comprehensive benchmark with a fine-grained taxonomy of 4 error types spanning 12 subcategories, a hierarchical evaluation protocol, and alignment-aware metrics, to systematically assess Multimodal Large Language Models' ability to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve flawed user inputs.
